pages.text: Willow Records retains signed agreements for 13 years. Access permissions are reviewed every 60 days.
Aspen Services repairs portable pumps within 9 business days. Customers must provide the equipment serial number.

Aspen Services accepts repair requests by email. Requests without the equipment serial number are returned to the sender for correction before a technician can schedule an inspection. This policy covers portable pumps only.
